description: This PHP source file defines the SeoUrl model class within the OpenCart admin module. It manages CRUD operations and retrieval of SEO URL records in the database, including filtering, sorting, and querying URLs by various parameters.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing SEO URL records in the database within the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addSeoUrl
methods.description: Inserts a new SEO URL record into the database with specified parameters and returns the new record's ID.

methods.name: editSeoUrl
methods.description: Updates an existing SEO URL record identified by its ID with new provided values.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrl
methods.description: Deletes a SEO URL record from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Deletes multiple SEO URL records matching specified key, value, store ID, and language ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all SEO URL records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all SEO URL records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record by its ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record matching the specified key, value, store ID, and optional language ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record matching the given keyword, store ID, and optional language ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrls
methods.description: Fetches multiple SEO URL records, filtered by various optional parameters like keyword, key, value, store, and language.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Returns SEO URL data indexed by store ID and language ID for a given key and value.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves all SEO URL records for a specific store.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all SEO URL records for a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalSeoUrls
methods.description: Counts total SEO URL records in the database, with optional filtering.
